Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Ben Simmons?

Ben Simmons is 30 years old.

Where was Ben Simmons born?

Ben Simmons was born in Melbourne, Australia.

When was Ben Simmons born?

Ben Simmons was born on July 20, 1996.

How tall is Ben Simmons?

Ben Simmons is 6-10 (208 cm) tall.

How much did Ben Simmons weigh when playing?

Ben Simmons weighed 240 lbs (108 kg) when playing.

Is Ben Simmons in the Hall of Fame?

Ben Simmons is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Ben Simmons drafted?

Ben Simmons was drafted by Philadelphia 76ers, 1st round (1st pick, 1st overall), 2016 NBA Draft.

What position did Ben Simmons play?

Point Guard.

When did Ben Simmons retire?

Ben Simmons last played in 2025.

What is Ben Simmons' net worth?

Ben Simmons made at least $203,537,575 playing professional basketball.

How much did Ben Simmons make?

Ben Simmons made $39,256,083 in 2025.

What did Ben Simmons average?

Ben Simmons averaged 13.1 points, 7.4 rebounds, and 7.2 assists per game.

How many rings does Ben Simmons have?

Ben Simmons won 0 championships.

What is Ben Simmons' Instagram account?

Ben Simmons is on Instagram at bensimmons.

What schools did Ben Simmons attend?

Ben Simmons attended Montverde Academy in Montverde, Florida and LSU.

What are Ben Simmons' nicknames?

Simmo the Savage, Young Socialite, Fresh Prince, Peacemaker, Benny, The Yank, Big Ben, The Wizard of Oz are nicknames for Ben Simmons.

Can Ben Simmons shoot threes?

Only in Instagram videos.
